# Draft:Howard Weiss

----
Howard Weiss is an American photojournalist and freelance photographer based in Brooklyn, New York. He is the founder of the photography platform NYC in Focus.
Early life and education
Weiss was born in Brooklyn and first discovered his passion for photography as a freshman at John Dewey High School.
Career
Prior to his career in photojournalism, Weiss worked in public service for the government and the USPS.
Weiss documented the aftermath of the September 11 attacks, capturing images of rescue efforts at Ground Zero. He accessed the site using a Minolta camera and a police scanner.
He founded NYC in Focus in 2013, a platform focusing on event and street photography. He serves as a contributor to BK Reader, covering local events such as the TCS New York City Marathon and cultural celebrations.
His photography has been featured in MSN, Yahoo!, and Insider Sport, covering subjects ranging from major sports events to lifestyle trends.
